verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to a published OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec on openpm (openpm.ai/packages/reflect/openapi.json). It documents the REST endpoints (graphs, links, daily-notes, notes, users/me) and the OAuth2 scopes, so a downloadable machine-readable spec exists. The probe's 404s only show the spec isn't at the vendor's own domain paths; they don't contradict the openpm-hosted spec. missing for 10: spec hosted on a third-party registry rather than first-party paths, early version 0.1.0 with no versioning or deprecation policy, no independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec matches the live API.
